patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,108 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.frame_scores = []
+        self.current_frame = 0
+        self.frame_rolls = []
+        self.game_over = False
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.game_over:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Negative roll is invalid")
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            
+        # Check if we're in the 10th frame
+        if self.current_frame == 9:
+            return self._handle_tenth_frame(pins)
+        else:
+            return self._handle_regular_frame(pins)
+
+    def _handle_regular_frame(self, pins):
+        self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        
+        # Strike
+        if pins == 10 and len(self.frame_rolls) == 1:
+            self.frame_scores.append((10, True, False))  # (score, is_strike, is_spare)
+            self.current_frame += 1
+            self.frame_rolls = []
+        # Second roll of frame
+        elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+            frame_total = sum(self.frame_rolls)
+            if frame_total > 10:
+                raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            is_spare = (frame_total == 10)
+            self.frame_scores.append((frame_total, False, is_spare))
+            self.current_frame += 1
+            self.frame_rolls = []
+
+    def _handle_tenth_frame(self, pins):
+        self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        
+        # Handle third roll validation
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:
+            # If first two rolls are strike or spare, third is allowed
+            first_two = self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1]
+            if self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 or first_two == 10:
+                # Valid third roll
+                if self.frame_rolls[1] != 10 and first_two != 10:
+                    # Second roll wasn't strike/spare, so third shouldn't be possible
+                    raise ValueError("invalid fill balls")
+                self.game_over = True
+            else:
+                # First two rolls didn't earn a third roll
+                raise ValueError("invalid fill balls")
+        elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+            frame_total = sum(self.frame_rolls)
+            if frame_total < 10:
+                # Open frame - no third roll
+                self.game_over = True
+        elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 1 and self.frame_rolls[0] < 10:
+            # First roll wasn't strike, so second roll is regular
+            pass
+
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.game_over and not (self.current_frame == 10 and len(self.frame_rolls) == 0):
+            # Check if 10th frame is complete
+            if self.current_frame < 9 or (self.current_frame == 9 and not self._is_tenth_frame_complete()):
+                raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        for frame in range(10):
+            if frame < 9:  # Frames 1-9
+                if self.rolls[roll_index] == 10:  # Strike
+                    total_score += 10 + self.rolls[roll_index + 1] + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                    roll_index += 1
+                elif self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1] == 10:  # Spare
+                    total_score += 10 + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                    roll_index += 2
+                else:  # Open frame
+                    total_score += self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                    roll_index += 2
+            else:  # 10th frame
+                if len(self.frame_rolls) >= 2:
+                    total_score += sum(self.frame_rolls[:2])
+                    if len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:
+                        total_score += self.frame_rolls[2]
+        
+        return total_score
+
+    def _is_tenth_frame_complete(self):
+        if self.current_frame < 9:
+            return False
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) == 0:
+            return True  # Already finished
+        
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) >= 2:
+            first_two = self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1]
+            if first_two < 10:  # Open frame
+                return True
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:  # Had bonus roll
+                return True
+        return False
